required_inputs: exact sealed BALA3 surface from successful v1.138

t2_decode_rule.first_decode: MF identificationRemarks token for row eligibility
t2_decode_rule.zero_or_absent_positive_rows: surveyed absence under the frozen v1.135 BALA3 island-phase quality gate

fold_logic.training_rows: all target rows belonging to other frozen eligible MF taxa
fold_logic.R2_zero_variance_columns: drop exactly as frozen in v1.140 fold manifest

primary.within_taxon: mean binary logloss(C,y) - mean binary logloss(R2,y)
primary.across_taxa: equal-weight mean of estimable heldout-taxon deltas
primary.bootstrap: 10,000 resamples of heldout-taxon deltas with replacement

secondary_nonrescuing.full_data_E_i_coefficient: fit the same R2/C design once to all eligible target rows and report the standardized E_i coefficient if both outcome classes have at least five rows
secondary_nonrescuing.row_mean_E_i_by_outcome: report mean E_i for contraction and persistence
secondary_nonrescuing.taxon_event_delta_N_eff_vs_contraction_f: Spearman across exactly-one-loss taxa with at least one target row
